lesson_title: Build vision and image-generation solution patterns in Foundry
learner_starting_state: Can distinguish visual analysis, multimodal prompting, and generation and can trace endpoint, credential, request, and response boundaries.
learner_ending_state: Can select and trace a safe Foundry visual solution pattern, validate media and request contracts, interpret the correct result shape, preserve provenance, and enforce action boundaries.
mastery_gate: Score 12 of 12 on primary and fresh-transfer forms across six visual solution boundaries, then explain one complete flow and its action safeguard without notes.

provenance_policy.citation_expectation: AI-901 scope and current Foundry SDK and Azure Vision claims cite official Microsoft sources.
provenance_policy.unsupported_claim_behavior: Reverify portal labels, supported models/capabilities, SDK/API versions, endpoints, authentication, media formats and limits, regions, quotas, pricing, safety controls, preview status, and deprecations before live use.

notes: Offline solution-pattern lab only; no media is opened, uploaded, generated, published, or deleted and no service or Azure action is authorized.
